_comment: Inventory of current capabilities and explicit limits. 'Implemented' includes the tested release path; 'partial' names scoped behavior and does not imply complete coverage.

partial.privacy.linkage: Within-run direct-identifier linkage plus exact patient-name-and-phone composite matching, with sex/DOB conflict checks. No name-only or phone-only links; broad alias resolution and cross-release identity resolution are unsupported.
partial.privacy.transforms: Deterministic event-date shifts, age bands, locality-to-district fallback, and PIN-prefix masking for supported structured fields and selected text cases. Coverage is format- and context-limited.
partial.privacy.pseudonymization: Domain-separated HMAC pseudonyms from the run secret and available record/linkage evidence; weak or ambiguous records may remain unlinked.
partial.evaluation.verification: Independent contract, scorecard, and verifier tools exist outside the runtime pipeline; the verifier is not an automatic release gate.

not_implemented.privacy.risk_assessment: Attack-based re-identification risk measurement or a validated k-anonymity guarantee.
not_implemented.security.encryption: Encryption and secure deletion for persisted sensitive intermediates; source values are held in process memory during parsing.
not_implemented.security.key_management: A key-rotation and lifecycle service beyond caller-supplied RAKSHA_SECRET.
not_implemented.fhir.full_r4_validation: Complete FHIR R4 schema validation and comprehensive reference-resolution validation.
not_implemented.detection.names: A separate names.py detector; current name rules are integrated into detection.engine.
not_implemented.detection.phone: A separate phone.py detector; current phone rules are in detection.identifiers.
not_implemented.detection.dates: A dedicated dates.py PII detector; date parsing and transformation utilities exist elsewhere.
not_implemented.detection.structured: A separate structured.py detector; current structural rules are in detection.structural.
not_implemented.detection.unstructured: A separate unstructured.py detector; current text rules are in detection.engine.
not_implemented.detection.gazetteers: A dedicated static clinical/person gazetteer package; no answer-key identities are bundled.
not_implemented.ingestion.json_parser: A separate json_parser.py; JSON uses the common IR JSON parser.
